In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched a '''blockade''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Core" /> Initially planned around the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to suppress the last flames of rebellion after the planned victory at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], with it also being planned to have the Death Star II destroy the planet in a matter of months,<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the blockade was delayed due to the death of the Emperor at Endor. It was eventually performed by seven Star Destroyers six months after Endor; [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] ordered the blockade as a means of holding Chandrila hostage to forestall the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] advance on Coruscant.<ref name="Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blockade was first mentioned in in ''[[Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant]]''. It was later revealed in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' that the invasion had actually been planned and almost executed concurrently to the Battle of Endor alongside a similar invasion at Mon Calamari. According to author [[Jason Fry]] in his end notes for the book, this development was included to rectify the debate as to whether the Empire used all of its forces or a minimum amount of its forces during the battle, and implied that the measure was a further display of Palpatine's overconfidence regarding the upcoming battle at Endor.<ref name="Tumblr-EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 12">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25364458982/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-12|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 12}}</ref>
